purpose: Independent published limits and analytic reference points for next-core; these are not measurements of the assembled household system

evidence.limitations: Peak efficiency does not establish efficiency at every load
Published peak W does not alone establish a peak VA or a 7.4 kVA motor-start capability
No full fuel curve, actual refuel delay or automated-start hardware published
Local solar time is not guaranteed to match US Eastern Standard Time

assumed_parameters.reason: 98% is a published PEAK, not a load-dependent efficiency curve
Lack of complete manufacturer I-V and MPPT tracking curves
Requires measured chemistry-, temperature- and SOC-specific curves
Only maximum efficiency and idle watts available, not a complete curve
Honda publishes only two runtime anchor points
Operator presence and startup/refuel time depend on situation

coverage.componentPhysics: partial: PV fixed Vmp, battery single OCV/R point, real/reactive AC limits, finite-fuel generator
coverage.wholeSystem: blocked pending independent measurement/reference data and integrated event scheduler
